LV_BREAKER.q: Which products does this FAQ cover?

LV_BREAKER.a: MCCB-ABS-103c: 18 months; MCCB-ABS-403c: 18 months; ACB-AS-2000: 24 months; ELCB-EBN-203c: 18 months. See POL-WARRANTY.

LV_BREAKER.q: What is the standard lead time?
LV_BREAKER.a: MCCB-ABS-103c: 4 weeks ex-works; MCCB-ABS-403c: 5 weeks ex-works; ACB-AS-2000: 8 weeks ex-works; ELCB-EBN-203c: 4 weeks ex-works. See POL-ORDER.
MCCB-ABS-103c: CE, CB, KC; MCCB-ABS-403c: CE, CB, KC, UL (-U variant); ACB-AS-2000: CE, KC, CB; ELCB-EBN-203c: CE, KC

LV_BREAKER.q: Where can I get manuals and datasheets?
LV_BREAKER.a: Each product has a datasheet (DS-), installation guide (IG-), troubleshooting guide (TG-) and release notes (RN-) or maintenance guide (MG-). Documents are in English.

LV_BREAKER.q: What information should I send when reporting a fault?
LV_BREAKER.a: Product model / ordering code, Serial number (nameplate), Error code or symptom displayed, Operating condition at failure (load, speed, temperature), Photos of product and nameplate, Load current / temperature records.

LV_BREAKER.q: How do I return a product?
LV_BREAKER.a: Request an RMA number first. Returns without RMA are refused. See POL-RETURN.
